captions: Create a manual reel and choose an empty project.
Add a video, then choose your footage in Windows Files. The file dialog is outside this app capture.
The imported source is ready. Open Pick to choose the moments for your reel.
Open Pick, click the start of a moment, press plus, then click its end.
Choose a second moment. Preview plays only the selected parts, skipping the gap.
Add words over the picture, after the selected part.
Preview keeps the footage moving while your title appears on top.
The Parts panel shows the running order. Drag a numbered handle to move a part.
Preview follows the new order. The title stays with its video block.
Add a photo as its own part. Choose the image in Windows Files, outside this app capture.
Set its duration, then play the photo part to see how long it stays in the reel.
Open the join before a photo and choose a cross dissolve from the gallery.
Play across the join: the moving footage blends into the still photograph.
Open Music and add the bundled Bouncy Groove track with plus.
The music lane now belongs to the reel. Play to check its timing with your pictures.
Open the video part settings. Each tab changes this part of the reel.
Zoom in to refine the composition, then compare the result in Preview.
Play the part to see the closer framing on moving footage.
Open Photo capture and enable it for this video part.
Choose when to capture, then set a short flash and a three-second hold.
Move the playhead past Capture at, into the held photo, to see your adjustments.
Tilt the photo, make it smaller and add a white border.
Custom frame chooses the area to photograph. Apply keeps the crop.
Press Play: the video flashes, holds a tilted framed photograph, then returns to motion.
Watch the complete reel with sound before saving and exporting.
Save keeps the editable project. Export creates a separate video file.
Choose the delivery size, quality and format, then use Export. This demo saves to a prepared folder.
The exported video is ready. The editable project remains available for later changes.
Auto Reel is an alternative starting point. Set the target duration, pacing and analysis precision.
Automatic duration chooses the length. Lower precision uses fewer analysis samples.
Create reel analyzes the media on this device. The waiting is shortened in this video.
Review the generated parts and play the draft before exporting.
On Windows, open Settings and the AI assistant guide.
Copy the full prompt into an AI chat with computer-control tools. You control files and exports.
